    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(41.6, 43.7)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, 20.8), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .sphere(43.7)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, -20.8), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .sphere(43.7)
    )
)

instruction: Remove the upper hemispherical end cap (the sphere at +Z); the cylinder body, the lower hemispherical cap at -Z, and the central bore stay the same. The result is a flat-topped half-capsule.
